act_title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Treat the Symptoms

quests.title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Treat the Symptoms

dialogue.t: Something's definitely wrong with those yellow-green stones... I think I'm going to die here.
Um, are you alright?
In the long run, we'll all be "fine," but I'm going to be "fine" before you are.

dialogue.sit: That's certainly a new way to use the word "fine."

dialogue.t: Wait a minute, this guy doesn't sound fine at all!
No, I'm fine, literally. If something's wrong, it's too late anyway...

dialogue.sit: So are you alright or not?

dialogue.t: Paimon's very confused. Can you please be more specific?
Specifically speaking, when I come to the production zone, I get headaches and heart palpitations, and my hands and feet grow cold!
I'm done for! Do you know what I mean? I'm done for!
It must be the yellow-green stones! They're evil! You know of those stones, right? The Central Laboratory of the Fontaine Research Institute...
The yellow-green stones destroyed everything!

dialogue.sit: Please just go see a doctor.
Why don't you rest up in the infirmary?

dialogue.t: I am a doctor! I know! Wait, I'm no longer a doctor. I lost my certification, and I can't give official diagnoses...
Please find a real doctor with certifications to save me! Please!
This sounds pretty serious. Let's go find a doctor, {NICKNAME}.
Are you in trouble? Or are others in trouble? You both look healthy, so it must be the latter.
Indeed...
Him again, huh?
His headache? Or his delusions?
Huh? You mean he's not that sick?
Based on his lab results, most likely not.
I heard that he misdiagnosed a patient when he was still on the outside, ignoring some early warning results, and healthcare outcome... Well, he's been a little paranoid ever since.
He's like that to others, and worse when it comes to himself.
No one else is having those same health issues, right?
But I can't very well ignore him, so please, give him this.
Isn't this Pure Water? Are you sure?
Oh, so you know what this is. It's fine in the sense that it does no harm to the body, and it'll give him a boost.

dialogue.sit: Why not just give him Fonta?

dialogue.t: As far as I know, he stays away from these drinks. But I gave it to him before, telling him it was a health potion, and he did actually show more vigor after drinking it.
Alright, we'll give this to him. If it doesn't work...
Then tell him to go lie down in the infirmary. If you tell him it's "doctor's orders," he'll listen.
Sure. Let's go back, {NICKNAME}.
I feel so weak... Must be those blasted yellow-green stones again...
We're back. The doctor gave you this.

dialogue.sit: Lechlade takes the Pure Water and drinks all of it immediately.

dialogue.t: Ah, me, that's better! Vigor fills me once again!

dialogue.sit: I don't think you were sick at all.

dialogue.t: Wasn't that a little too fast?
Arderne is a really good doctor, and certified, too! The medicine he prescribes always works. Unlike mine...
But what about the yellow-green stones?
Suspicious, of course!
Ugh, guess his delusions can't be helped.
Now I can keep working! Thank you so much for helping out. Here, take these Coupons — just a little something to show my appreciation.
Stay healthy!
Don't worry, Lechlade's just acting up again, that's all.

quests.description: Lechlade seems to believe that the source of his misery lies in the yellow-green stones…
